dhp100:4:
upasammati → sahasumapi vācānāmanaphapadasaṃhitā 
ekā aphavatī śreyā yaṃ śrætvā upaśāmyatī (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
sahasa bi ya vaśana anatha pada sahita 
eka gadha pada ṣebha ya ṣutva uvaśamati (prā. dhā. c. 72)
dhp101:4:
upasammati → sahasramapi gāthānāmanaphapadasaṃhitā 
ekā aphavatī śreyā yaṃ śrætvā upaśāmyati. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp102:4:
upasammati → ja gadha śata bhaṣe anata pada sahita. 
eka gadha pada ṣebho ya ṣūtva uvaśamati. (prā. dha. c. 10)
dhp103:4:
saṅgāmajuttamo → yo śatāni sahasrāṇāṃ saṃgrāme manujān jayet. 
yo caikaṃ jayedātamānaṃ sa vai saṃgrāmajīdavaraඃ (mahāvastu 3, 436 piṭa) 
yo sahasa sahasanī sagamī manuṣa jīni. 
eka ji...... atamana so ho sagamu utamu (prā. dha. c. 6)
dhp106:6:
hutaṃ → varṣe varṣeśvamedhena yo yajate śataṃ samāඃ 
māṃsāni ca na bādedyasatayoඃ puṇyaphalaṃ samam. (manu. v. 53) 
yo yajena sahasrāṇāṃ māse māse śatāśatam 
na so buddhe prasādasya kalāmarghati ṣoḍaśim. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
masi masi sahasina yo yaeva śatena ca 
nevi budhi prasadasa kala aveti ṣoḍaśa. (prā. dha.)
dhp107:6:
hutaṃ → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivedaganiṃ paricaranśacaret 
patrāhāro chamāvāsī karonto vividhaṃ tapam. 
yaśvaikaṃ bhāvitātmānaṃ muhūrtamapi pūjayet 
sa ekā pūjanā śreyo na ca varṣaśataṃ hutam (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ja vaṣa śata jatu agi pariyara vane 
........ sa pi telena diva ratra atadrita 
eka ji bhavitatmana muhūtaviva puae 
sayeva puyana ṣebha yajī vaṣa śata hotu. (prā. dha. C. 20, 21)
dhp108:4:
seyyā → yat kiṃvidiṣṭaṃ ca hutaṃ ca loke 
saṃvattaraṃ yajati puṇyaprekṣo 
sarvaṃ hi taṃ na caturbhāgameti 
abhivādanaṃ ujjugateṣu śreyami. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya kiji yiṭha va hota va loke. 
........................................................... 
........................................................... 
abhivadana ujukateṣu ṣiho (prā. dha. C. 22)
dhp109:4:
balaṃ → abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṃ vṛdedhāpasevinaඃ 
catvāri sampravarṭhante āyurvidyā yaśo balam. (manusmṛti 2.121) 
adhivadanaśilisa nica vṛḍhavasayino 
catvari tasa vardhati ayo kīrti subha bala. (prā. dha. C. 34.)
dhp110:4:
jhāyino → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivedaduඃśīlo asamāhitaඃ 
ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp112:4:
daḷhaṃ → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivet kuśido hīnavīryyavān 
ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ji vaṣa śata jivi kusidhu hinaviriyava 
muhutu jīvita ṣeha viriya arahato dāḍha. (prā. dha. C 17)
dhp113:4:
udayavyayaṃ → yo ca....... apaśyaṃ udayavyayam 
....... paśyato udayavyayam. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ji vaṣa śata jivi apaśu udakavaya 
muhuta jivita ṣehu paśato udakavaya. (prā. dha C 18)
dhp114:4:
padaṃ → yo ca....... apaśyaṃ amātaṃ padam 
......... paśyato amātaṃ padam. (mahāvastu. 3. 436 piṭa)
dhp115:4:
dhammamuttamaṃ → yo ca ......... apaśyaṃ dhammuttamam 
...... paśyato dhammamuttamam. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ja vaṣa śata jīvi apaśu dhamu utamu 
muhuta jīvita sehu paśatu dhamu utamu. (prā. dha. G. 19)
